goal: Resolve a RAT device candidate after canonical Drive recognition while preserving open-set abstention and preventing automatic control delivery.

architecture.identity: Frozen seven-pedal ONNX scores from identity/1.0.0
architecture.pair: Read-only Clean/Wet spectral transfer, coherence, onset, and envelope features
architecture.head: Balanced train-only-selected classifier with an independently calibrated RAT threshold

identity.reason: The generic seven-class candidate reached only 40.625 percent total RAT recall. Lowering its threshold could not repair non-RAT argmax errors.

scores.reason: A head using only frozen identity scores reached 62.5 percent recall and 6.25 percent DFZ false routing.

development.scope: ASRNN official eval is development validation because an earlier identity-only audit exposed a subset before route training.

data.source: ASRNN official RAT and DFZ train/eval splits

decision: Admit route/1.0.0 as an optional non-commercial development package in shadow mode. It may propose RAT after an accepted Drive family, but an explicit user/device choice remains required before the RAT adapter can deliver controls.
next: Acquire or designate a new untouched session/device-disjoint RAT and non-RAT Drive set, then freeze a final route gate before enabling automatic adapter selection.
